- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment phases (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices during low sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — add 3–5% to forecast to compensate for mean reversion bias.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below true peak in subsequent days.
- Lagged price movements: if sentiment rises sharply, forecast should not lag more than 2–3 days behind true trend.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, adjust downward by 2–4% per day until convergence.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate early in trend (first 5–7 days) — reduce first 5 days by 3–5% if sentiment is rising.
